identification.notes: The advertised name is the prefix followed by a device serial; the vendor apps filter on the ["YS", "TL"] prefix list and nothing else. A match means "a LOY SPACE platform panel", not this SKU. Select a freshly discovered device by exact advertised name plus FFF0 when several units may be present. A live unit appeared at a different random-format address after an earlier address-based connection failed, so do not persist a stale MAC as identity.

device.name: AUTOBABA LED Backpack
device.notes:
Programmable full-color LED backpack screen using the LOY SPACE / popled.cn protocol family (shared with NYAN GEAR). BLE is established; whether this particular backpack also has Wi-Fi is unknown. BLE device name starts with "YS" or "TL", which identifies only the platform, not the reseller, controller revision or matrix geometry.
Commands use checksummed AA 55 FF FF frames with a little-endian length, sequence, flags/mode and binary TLV records. A stream builder can add a separate outer u16 record length, but an individual GATT write must not blindly prepend it. TLV value lengths are one byte below 0x80, 0x81 plus one byte for 128-255, or 0x82 plus a little-endian u16 for 256 and above. Thus 81 c4 means a 196-byte value, not a magic constant. Normal app writes start around 180 bytes, with larger MTU-dependent paths; resource data is normally split at 960 bytes with a 997-byte TLV limit and a big-endian u16 resource chunk count. Third-party raw-GIF uploads on another backpack do not establish that this unit accepts them.
Backend API: store-cdn.popled.cn. Sliding-window ACK and app-side JSON command shapes are documented below, but the JSON itself never crosses the link. Source evidence is LOY SPACE Android 1.2.19 plus public client projects. Every command is reported until captured on this hardware.

credentials.notes: Anything within radio range can connect and issue commands. Physical proximity is the only access control.

factory_reset.effect: No credential state to clear. Power-cycling drops the current connection, which is the actual remedy for the common failure mode: the device already being connected to another central.

steps.action: Remove power (or battery) for a few seconds and reapply.
steps.expect: Device advertises again and accepts a new connection.

methods.description: No provisioning step: the device advertises as soon as it is powered on and accepts a connection from any central. There is no account, no network credential exchange and no pairing PIN, so a replacement client only has to scan, connect and write.

steps.action: Power the device and scan for its advertisement.
Connect and run the documented initialization sequence, if the spec defines one.

setup.notes: The vendor app advertises WiFi support for this product family, but the documented control path is BLE only and needs no provisioning. If a WiFi mode exists on a given unit it has not been captured here.

rejoin.notes: Nothing binds this device to a network or an owner, so switching controllers is just connecting from the new one. If the old client is an Android or iOS phone, remove the device from the OS Bluetooth list as well — a cached bond can keep the phone reconnecting automatically and holding the single available link.

testing.notes: Live owner-authorized GATT discovery on 2026-11-07 confirmed FFF0, FFF2 write-without-response and FFF1 notify, plus the secondary 5833ff01-9b8b-5191-6142-22a4536ef123 service. No characteristic read, subscription, command write, pairing, reset or firmware operation was performed. Display commands, geometry and upload behavior remain untested by this project.

features.notes: No fixed geometry is claimed. Read panel TLV 0x1b for big-endian width and height. Raw-GIF acceptance on another backpack is not proof that this unit accepts the simplified third-party route.

helpful_urls.description: The vendor app's listing, which is the only vendor-published documentation this hardware has — the backpacks themselves ship with no manual and no brand.
helpful_urls.title: LOY SPACE app (Google Play)

initialization.notes: Open display replies before any information query or display command.

panel_discovery.query_notes: Source-derived 20-byte query with sequence 1, not sent by this project. Subscribe to FFF1 first and use FFF2 without response. The real client increments its sequence counter; 1 is only the worked example. Device-information TLV 0x0a reports identity/model/version; panel TLV 0x1b reports big-endian width and height. The app's initial 64x64 value is a default, not evidence for this backpack.

resource_framing.note: Logical resource chunks are not GATT writes; larger MTU-dependent paths exist.

tlv_length_encoding.extended_16: 82 LL LH: little-endian u16 length (256 and above)

remaining_unknowns: Whether any scan-time signal separates the LOY SPACE, NYAN GEAR and LED space products: all three apps filter on the same ["YS", "TL"] name prefixes and the same 0xFFF0 service, and no capture of a NYAN or YSP-001 unit's advertisement exists to compare against. Until one does, this spec is the family fallback and a YS*/TL* panel resolves here. The dev_info reply (dev_model) after connect is the likely discriminator.

Exact controller revision, firmware, matrix geometry, official MTU, raw-GIF acceptance, animation behavior and status-code meanings remain unverified. No display command was sent during the 2026-11-07 live session.

The 5833ff service is shared with unrelated products and is not an AUTOBABA identifier. SBH OTA and authenticated/ELS roles are described on other hardware, but this backpack's role, commands, accepted images and recovery path are unknown.

characteristics.name: Notify
characteristics.notes: Display acknowledgements and TLV responses. Live GATT discovery confirmed notify on 2026-11-07. Subscribe before sending a display query. Reassemble AA55 frames by their declared length; one notification is not necessarily one complete frame.

play_program.description: Play a program by index. This uni-app binding sends the single-slot form: {"cmd":{"pgm_play":{"model":0,"index":N}}, "sno":N}. The sibling com.yj.led (LED space) binding sends pgm_play with the full 60-slot ids_pro array instead — both are real JSON shapes for the same LOY SPACE pgm_play opcode across app versions (see led-space.yaml play_program). On the wire, hardware-verified RE (samrodrigues/loy-space-protocol) shows program selection is a single zero-based slot index.

characteristics.name: Write
characteristics.notes: Display-command writes. Live GATT discovery confirmed only write-without-response on 2026-11-07; use response=False. App-side commands are JSON objects wrapped as {"cmd": <command>, "sno": <sequence>}, serialized to binary TLV before send. A stream builder can add an outer u16 record length, but do not blindly prepend it to an individual GATT write. The AA55 frame itself carries a little-endian additive checksum of every preceding byte.

characteristics.name: Secondary write (role unverified)
characteristics.notes: Live-confirmed property. This is a response write, unlike FFF2.

characteristics.name: Secondary notification (role unverified)
characteristics.notes: Live-confirmed property. No subscription or command was attempted.

services.name: Secondary vendor service (role unverified)
services.notes: Present in live discovery, but not used by the analyzed LOY SPACE display path. A public DCloud profile calls this family SBH OTA; BanlanX research describes authenticated/ELS control on other firmware. Other LOY SPACE panel research also leaves this channel unused. Those are possible roles on other hardware, not evidence of this backpack's role. Do not send display, authentication or firmware commands here. Its protocol, accepted images and recovery path are unknown.
